updated.description: ISO date of the last edit to this file.

id.description: Stable slug, never reused or renamed: acronym-year, e.g. iclr-2027. Used in URLs, saved watchlists and paper-progress keys — changing it orphans a user's tracked papers.

name.description: Display name including the year, e.g. "ICLR 2027". For workshops, the short workshop name without the host.

hostVenueId.description: Required for workshops: the id of the conference it is co-located with. null for conferences.

broadScope.description: true for general-purpose venues (NeurIPS, ICML, AAAI) that accept most ML subfields. Softens a weak topic match to partial.

event.description: When the event runs. Both ends are null together when the venue has not announced its dates — a normal state for a cycle whose CFP is open but whose location is still TBA. Never write "TBD" or a guessed date into these fields.

end.description: Same as start for a single-day workshop. null when start is null.

fee.description: Free text with currency symbol as published, e.g. "$850", "€780", "included in ICLR registration". Never converted. Use this when the venue publishes a blob rather than a table; use `tiers` when it publishes a table.

tiers.description: The published fee table, one entry per row. Empty when the venue has not published fees — the cost estimator then takes a hand-entered figure instead. Never estimate a fee, and never convert one: `currency` records what was published.

amount.description: As published, in major units. No conversion, no rounding.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for the currency the fee was published in.

cutoff.description: Last day this rate applies, when the venue publishes one. null for rates with no date attached.

note.description: Qualifier as published, e.g. "IEEE member", "includes banquet".

topics.description: Broad topics only — each must appear in taxonomy.json#/topics. Three to six per venue; listing everything destroys the match signal.

rankings.description: Use the string "—" for genuinely unranked, never "N/A" or an empty string. h5Index is a number as a string.

latestPct.description: Most recent published main-track acceptance rate, or null when the venue publishes no figure. Never estimate one — DATA_GUIDE forbids it. A null record is shown as "acceptance not published" and is kept by the acceptance range filter unless the reader opts out, rather than being assigned a fake value.

latestYear.description: Which edition `latestPct` describes. Required whenever latestPct is non-null, because the figure is usually the previous edition's and a rate shown without its year reads as this year's. null exactly when latestPct is null.

history.description: Oldest first. Omit years with no published figure rather than interpolating.

blindingNote.description: Qualifier shown after the blinding type, e.g. "via ACL Rolling Review".

deadlines.description: The full chain in chronological order. The app derives the countdown from the first entry still in the future, so a venue whose chain has entirely passed correctly reads as a closed cycle. An empty array is permitted only when the venue genuinely publishes no itemised dates; it reads as "no dates published" and never as a deadline of zero. Never invent an entry to satisfy this field.

stage.description: Free text, but stay consistent across venues: Abstract, Paper submission, Supplementary, ARR commitment, Reviews released, Rebuttal closes, Notification, Camera-ready.

date.description: The ORIGINAL published date. Never overwrite it with an extension.

extendedTo.description: Set only when officially extended. The UI strikes through `date` and shows this instead.

extensionNote.description: Why, in one clause: "extended after submission-site outage".

timezone.description: AoE unless the CFP says otherwise.

coLocatedWorkshops.description: Shown on the conference. A workshop that is also its own venue record should appear in both places.

note.description: The evidence, factually and without adjectives. This is a public accusation — it must be defensible.

reviewed.description: Month and year the claim was last checked, e.g. "June 2026".

sources.description: Required in practice. Do not flag a venue you cannot cite.

integrityFlag.description: null for the overwhelming majority of venues. Absence of a flag is not an endorsement and the UI never claims otherwise.

cfp.description: Call-for-papers page — the page carrying the deadlines in this record.

notes.description: One or two sentences of submitter-relevant process detail: binding abstract deadlines, mandatory intent-to-submit, dual-submission policy, summary-reject phases. Not marketing copy.

source.description: Provenance. A venue with no source entry must not ship.

verifiedOn.description: When a human last checked these dates against the official page.

confidence.description: confirmed: on the official CFP. provisional: announced but unpaged. projected: inferred from previous years — the UI must label these.
